propositions: A derived-and-diff guard script must parse autodeploy.sh path manifests and Dockerfile/compose COPY/ENTRYPOINT directives to detect when deploy-relevant files added to the repo are not listed in any manifest entry.

The Dockerfile/compose parser must resolve container paths to repo-relative POSIX paths, discard non-existent files and build artifacts, and only keep script references that resolve to real `.sh` files in the repository.

Coverage matching must mirror git-pathspec semantics: a derived path counts as covered when any manifest entry is an exact match OR the derived path falls under a directory prefix (trailing slash normalized), not exact string membership.
A commented fail-safe exclusion list must encode intentional exceptions with inline reasons and verify each excluded path names a real repo file, preventing silent drift.

The check must be integrated into `make lint` and pre-commit hooks to run portably across CI environments, and must pass on origin/main with all four historically-drifted file classes caught (mcp-entrypoint.sh, materialize-deploy-key.sh, materialize-*.sh, nginx edge paths).
